name: NEXTDC S4 Sydney

address.value: 16 Johnston Crescent, Horsley Park NSW (Lot 305 DP 1275011)
address.note: Some listings (datacenterHawk, datacentermap) give 3-5 Johnston Crescent; the SSD application and Multiplex use 16 Johnston Crescent

postcode.note: standard postcode for Horsley Park; not stated in the sources consulted

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 16 Johnston Crescent (large lot; campus-level)

builder.note: head contractor; engaged on design April 2022, ECI from mid-2024, construction started 2026

mw_it.note: portal project description: 'six data centre buildings ... operational capacity of 250 MW'. The Assessment Report (source 8) describes the approved amended development as 'power consumption of 294 MW' (original EIS 232 MW); NEXTDC now markets S4 at 365 MW IT (source 11), which appears to include the separate Phase 2 SSD-108864209 (134.4 MW max power consumption, source 12). Multiplex says 350 MW; the 2021 ASX release targeted 300 MW

mw_grid.note: 'power consumption of 294 MW' for the development as amended (Sept 2025) and approved; the EIS as exhibited was 232 MW. Two 330 kV underground lines (2.6 km) from Transgrid Sydney West substation

cost_aud_m.note: estimated development cost $3,177,382,221 (excl. GST) for the amended application, per the Department's Assessment Report and the RTS/Amendment Report (source 10); includes $155m for the HV connection. The EIS as exhibited had an EDC of $2,378,800,000 (source 9). Earlier value 1100 was a media figure (The Urban Developer, $1.1bn, apparently the first stage); land cost about $124m in 2021 (source 5)

authority.value: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure
authority.note: determined by the Executive Director, Energy, Resources and Industry Assessments, under delegation

reference.note: SEARs request 16 Oct 2023 under PDA-63433217. Mod-1 (SSD-63741210-Mod-1, design modifications) approved 07/08/2026 (source 13). Separate project 'NEXTDC S4 Data Centre Phase 2, Horsley Park' is SSD-108864209 (at Prepare EIS stage, source 12)

lodged.note: estimate: the EIS is dated 20 June 2024 and SSDA documents were uploaded 20 June 2024; exhibited 26 Jul - 22 Aug 2024. Amended application accepted 9 Sep 2025. Exact lodgement date not stated

determined.note: portal Project Details: Decision Approved, Determination Date 24/12/2025, Decider Executive Director. Mod-1 approved 07/08/2026

jobs_construction.note: Multiplex: 1,800 workers onsite at peak construction (not re-verified: multiplex.global returns 403). Much higher than the planning documents' on-site figure (250-300 daily workers at peak, Stage 1), which may reflect a different stage or definition

jobs_construction_other.note: Assessment Report: 'up to 1,111 full-time equivalent construction jobs'; EIS (source 9): 'Approximately 1,111 full-time equivalent employees' (construction). Period not stated; tagged as FTE | basis set to unstated: 'full-time equivalent construction jobs' does not say headcount vs job-years or the period
RTS/Amendment Report, construction traffic: 'around 250-300 construction workers will access the site daily' during peak construction (Stage 1, about 18 months). Upper end of range recorded
HV transmission line works only: 'Peak construction workforce of around 70 personnel (excludes traffic management personnel)'
NEXTDC ASX release 28 Jul 2021: 'more than 500 jobs during the development phase'

jobs_operational.note: EIS and RTS: 'Operation: Approximately 411 specialist and related full-time roles (maximum of 196 staff at any given time)'; Assessment Report: '411 full-time operational jobs'

jobs_operational_other.note: 'maximum of 196 staff at any given time' (three 8-hour shifts)

construction_start.note: work commenced / ground broken March 2026 (Multiplex release, early April 2026 coverage)

construction_end.note: expected mid-2027 for the first stage (Multiplex). Planning documents: construction in four stages over about five years (Stage 1 = Building C, HV switching building, 330 kV substation), operations to commence 2028 (RTS)

open_questions: exact SSD lodgement date not stated (EIS dated 20 June 2024)
MW: portal description 250 MW vs approved power consumption 294 MW vs NEXTDC 365 MW IT; Phase 2 SSD-108864209 (134.4 MW, 2 buildings, Prepare EIS) may need its own record or merging
buildings: portal description says six; EIS had five; amended/approved scheme is two adjoined four-storey buildings (AB and CD)
Multiplex 1,800 peak workers and construction start (Mar 2026) not re-verified (multiplex.global returns 403)
